review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-029 specifies the mandatory data fields (fault identifier, affected subsystem, time of detection, fault description) for each fault recorded in the mission fault log by the SFMC software. This is a functional data logging requirement. It contains no vague criteria, undefined ambiguous terms, escape clauses, or allocation problems. It does not specify a safety inhibit, interlock, or automated protective response, so SWE-184 is not linked.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-029 is an acceptable software requirement specifying the mandatory fields for each entry in the mission fault log.
